limitations: Historical development reuse, not untouched validation.
Top-k coverage is a retrospective ranking, not a deployable live policy.
The 3,223 settled fixtures are a subset of issued targets; full ATP/Challenger coverage is not established.
Order-averaged four-way attribution is algebraic, not causal.
No production activation, migration, deployment or provider spend.

market_benchmark.booking_note: The benchmark uses only a pre-issue quote that existed at or before the original prediction as_of. It is not a closing-line or execution result.

population_reconciliation.reconciliation_note: These are four settlement snapshots and one expanded target universe, not four independent eligibility definitions. The CSV census contains the exact 3,223 settled ids and every exclusion reason. Later snapshots add settled fixtures; they do not add model skill.

provenance.identity_merge_risk_note: A model id receiving multiple live ids is expected for fragmented source identities; each such merge must have one unambiguous alias/mapping. AMBIGUOUS or multi-candidate slots are the fail-closed risk set.
